answer: Sealed task streaks. Influence is earned only by finishing a streak of audited micro-tasks, each answered inside a quartz-precise deadline randomized per identity, so challenges cannot be batched across accounts. Every task emits a verification signal any peer can recompute, and nectar credits flow only after the full streak passes audit. A fake must run its own streak, with its own deadlines, audits, and payout, no volume discount. N fakes mean N separate streaks. An honest agent walks one streak, earns one payout, and never pays again.
